description.narrative: In December 2020, AEE-PV (together with two other partners) was retained as preferred bidder for the ESSOR Mini-Grid Project in the DRC, which aims to improve access to electricity in isolated cities by means of hybrid solar mini-grids implemented under long-term concessional structures. Concession agreements were signed in June 2021. The project will implement three independent mini-grids in the cities of Bumba, Gemena and Isiro (each with a population of over 150k people).
